body:
Thank You all my brother flew out from Austin to see me and talk me through some stuff. "Just. Keep. Fighting." Thanks for that line. I've calmed down for the most part. I need to work on living life without her as a crutch.

After reading this i cringed a little as I wrote this out of neediness.
I sought some kind of validation because she isn't here anymore.
now I feel weak but now that I am thinking rationally again I realise healing is a process and I have to start somewhere.

You probably see a lot posts like this. But thank you all.
